Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You sweep your hand across the ground, calling a tangle of thorns into the opening.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Up to 3/5/7 connected visible unoccupied ground squares, each within 4 squares.
Duration
Until the end of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Control

Roll Reason, then raise a waist-high hedge in up to the indicated number of squares. Place one connected area, with squares joined along their edges.

Weak
3 squares.
Standard
5 squares.
Strong
7 squares.

The hedge makes those squares difficult terrain and gives heavy cover across them until the end of your next turn. It remains passable and deals no damage.
